title: What If Cash Vanished — Day 1 (pipeline test)

lines.text: Tonight, every dollar bill in America vanishes.
Only sixteen percent of Americans prefer to pay in cash.
lines.source: Federal Reserve, Diary of Consumer Payment Choice (2026)

lines.text: But for five point six million households with no bank account, day one is when the trouble starts.
lines.source: FDIC National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked Households (2023)
